_meta.source: Poly Haven public API (api.polyhaven.com) + CDN dl.polyhaven.org; all assets CC0

verification.method: curl -sI on every URL in this file; status + content-length + access-control-allow-origin recorded per entry

gltf_loading.finding: Each .gltf references its .bin as "<id>.bin" and its images as "textures/<file>". On the CDN the .bin DOES resolve next to the .gltf (Models/gltf/1k/<id>/<id>.bin -> 200), but "Models/gltf/1k/<id>/textures/<file>" returns 404: textures live in Models/jpg/1k/<id>/<file>. So GLTFLoader needs a URL modifier (or remap via the include map).
gltf_loading.alternative: Or use each entry's "include" map: setURLModifier(url => includeByBasename[url.split("/").pop()]?.url ?? url).
gltf_loading.axis_and_units: glTF 2.0, Y-up, meters (Blender glTF exporter, +Y up). dims_m below are measured from the glTF accessors in glTF space [x, y(up), z]; info_dims_m_blender_xyz is the API value in Blender order [x, y, z(up)] - they match with y/z swapped.
gltf_loading.foliage_alpha_gotcha: All foliage materials (tree twigs, fern, shrub, grass, potted-plant leaves) use a 3-channel JPG as baseColor, so the glTF alphaMode MASK/BLEND has no alpha to cut with and leaf cards render as opaque rectangles (fir_sapling twigs are even exported OPAQUE). Fix per entry.alpha_fix: load alphaMap (grayscale JPG; three.js reads G) and set material.alphaMap = tex; material.alphaTest = 0.5; material.transparent = false; material.side = THREE.DoubleSide.
gltf_loading.include_bin_note: The API include map points the .bin at the 4k/8k folder; the identically sized copy next to the 1k .gltf also resolves, so the default relative .bin path is fine.
gltf_loading.browser_test: 2026-09-27: loaded 22 of 27 models (all except fir_sapling, fir_sapling_medium, fir_tree_01, pine_sapling_medium, pine_tree_01 - skipped for size) with three.js r170 GLTFLoader + the url_modifier_rule from a cross-origin page (https://api.polyhaven.com): 22/22 OK, 0 loader errors, every texture decoded, Box3 sizes identical to dims_m. Without the modifier the texture URL returns 404.

_meta.textures_note: maps are 1k JPG unless res says 2k. "arm" packs AO(R) / Roughness(G) / Metalness(B) - exactly the channels three.js reads for aoMap/roughnessMap/metalnessMap, so diff + nor_gl + arm is enough (bytes_min); "rough" is listed as requested. Set colorSpace=SRGBColorSpace on diff only. Repeat = surface_size_m / size_m. aoMap needs uv (r152+ uses uv channel 0 by default via aoMap.channel).
_meta.hdri_note: Load with RGBELoader (or HDRLoader in r180+), set texture.mapping = EquirectangularReflectionMapping, use as scene.background and scene.environment (PMREM is automatic for environment). Pure-sky HDRIs have no ground: the lower half is a flat horizon haze, so place your own ground/lake plane.

hdris.purpose: day: bright partly-cloudy midday, blue sky + cumulus, strong sun (EV cap 21) -> crisp shadows; no buildings/ground (pure sky, lower hemisphere is flat haze)
late afternoon: warm low sun with clouds, strong sun (EV cap 21) -> long warm shadows; pure sky
sunset (alt): soft golden sunset, low-contrast (EV cap 12) -> soft/weak sun shadows, use with an added DirectionalLight; pure sky

no_good_match.floor_lamp: No floor lamp on Poly Haven (Lighting/Floor & Desk only has desk_lamp_arm_01 and industrial_pipe_lamp).
no_good_match.rug: No rug/carpet model on Poly Haven (only fabric textures, e.g. carpet textures could be applied to a flat box).
no_good_match.bed: No modern double bed. GothicBed_01 (ornate four-poster), old_bed_frame (single metal frame), vintage_day_bed (daybed) are the only beds.
no_good_match.sofa: No modern/contemporary sofa; all 5 sofas are vintage (Victorian, Chinese, painted wood).
no_good_match.trees: Every conifer is heavy (21.9 MB to 958 MB at 1k) because needles are real geometry and the .bin is shared across all texture resolutions (no LOD / no Draco). None is < 15 MB.
no_good_match.standing_seam_roof: No standing-seam texture; closest are corrugated_iron_02 (grey, tintable) and box_profile_metal_sheet (trapezoid, red).
